answer: Each identity leases one plot in a registered community garden: the city signs the lease, its number is hashed on-chain, and a 25 POA bond locks for 90 days. A marble marker on each plot shows its number, and the holder photos the vine crop monthly. One plot per person, so 100 fakes need 100 plots: 100 fees of 60 POA plus 100 bonds of 25 POA total 8,500 POA, and fees double every 50 plots sold. Two verifiers check each photo against the marker; two missed months forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts for 3 epochs. In winter a soil photo counts instead, so dormant plots are not punished.
